meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目配置语言服务器，让代码诊断和跳转生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你为项目配置语言服务器（LSP），让代码诊断、跳转到定义、查找引用、重命名等功能正常工作。它会检测项目语言、安装服务器、写入配置，并验证是否成功。
howto.when: 当你需要配置或安装语言服务器、修复“未配置 LSP 服务器”或“服务器未安装”等错误时触发。也适用于在多个服务器之间做选择（如 basedpyright vs pyright）。

say.text: 帮我为这个 Python 项目配置语言服务器。
检查一下这个 TypeScript 项目的 LSP 是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会运行验证脚本，报告诊断是否成功。

say.text: 我想用 ruff 代替 pyright，帮我改配置。
say.note: Claude 会修改配置文件，切换服务器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help configure a Language Server (LSP) for a project, enabling diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, and rename. It detects the language, installs the server, writes config, and verifies the setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' or 'server not installed' errors, or choose between multiple servers (e.g., basedpyright vs pyright).

say_en.text: Set up a language server for this Python project.
say_en.note: Claude will detect, install, and configure the Python LSP server.

say_en.text: Check if the LSP is working for this TypeScript project.
say_en.note: Claude runs the verification script and reports success or failure.

say_en.text: Switch from pyright to ruff in the config.
say_en.note: Claude updates the config file to use ruff instead.
